Case study
Twelve seats at Ida's workshop
Ida Lund runs Northwind's onboarding workshop for new customers. Follow one Thursday session from the setting to Clara's seat, Ida's attendee list and a seat given back.
Payments & Seats
Turn on seats and set how many
Ida turns on Offer seats, sets 12 seats per time slot and ticks Show the number of available seats. The guests field goes away, so each booking is one person.
Booking page
Clara sees the seats left on every time
She opens the link in London. 9:00am is full and can't be picked, 11:00am has 4 seats left, and she takes one of them.
Booking form
One seat, booked in her own name
The form shows 4 of 12 seats left while she fills it in. She confirms and gets her own confirmation and calendar invite.
Bookings
Ida sees everyone in one booking
Each new seat emails Ida and joins the same booking. Her attendee list for Thursday now reads 9/12 slots taken.
Cancel
One person cancels, the workshop stays
Reilly can't make it and cancels. Only his seat goes, so Ida's list drops to 8/12 and 11:00am offers 4 seats again.

Questions about seats
How seats fill, what bookers see, and what happens when someone drops out.
Ask a question
What are seats?
A setting on an event type that lets several people book the same time slot, up to the number of seats you set. Each person books their own seat, and they all join one booking with the host.
How many seats can a time slot have?
Up to 1,000. You set the number in the event type's Payments & Seats tab, and you can change it later.
What do bookers see on the booking page?
With Show the number of available seats on, every time says how many seats are left. With it off, a time says Seats filling fast once half the seats are taken and Seats almost full from 83%. A full time reads No more seats available and can't be picked.
Can attendees see who else is coming?
Only if you turn on Share attendee information between guests. Without it, each attendee sees the host and themselves, and the host sees everyone.
What happens when one attendee cancels?
Only their seat is cancelled. The event goes ahead for everyone else, and the seat opens up on the booking page again. A host can also remove a single seat without cancelling the event.
Does anything turn off when I offer seats?
Yes. The booking form's guests field is hidden, so each booking is one person, and the event keeps a single duration. Seats can't be combined with multiple locations, a recurring event or a no-show fee.
